title: Drumming Interdependence
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching is about the importance of embracing uncertainty and letting go of ego in spiritual practice. Nomon Tim Burnett shares an experience with drumming classes as a metaphor for how we can learn to trust ourselves and let our natural abilities emerge when we release our need to control or figure things out. This approach is contrasted with the tendency to doubt and seek external validation, highlighting the value of cultivating mindfulness, joy, and wisdom by acknowledging and working with our own limitations rather than trying to overcome them.
